featured.title: Europe Faces Renewed Migration Challenge
featured.content: The humanitarian situation in Spain's Ceuta enclave remains a major focus as European leaders continue discussions on border security, migration management and humanitarian assistance following recent migrant crossings.

articles.description: Nigeria's ban on sachet alcoholic beverages is now being implemented. Authorities say the measure aims to reduce alcohol abuse, while some manufacturers and retailers have raised concerns about its economic impact.
